openings.claim: Use manifest-ordered digest comparisons and an evidence ledger to report the earliest supported divergent stage or an explicit unresolved interval for each of the six pairs.
openings.delta: Add conservative interval reporting to ordinary digest comparison: a missing boundary prevents narrowing beyond its evidence, while timestamps and warnings remain separate annotations.
openings.prediction: After transform-record removal, affected claims will retain a definite stage only when surviving records support it; otherwise their intervals will widen. The anomalous export timestamp will not reverse manifest stage order. These are workflow predictions, not observed results.
openings.probe: A local script aligns supplied records by manifest stage and identifiers, comparing like input and output boundaries. Report a definite earliest stage only when its comparable inputs agree, its outputs differ, and all preceding boundaries are supported equal. Otherwise report the unresolved span bounded by the latest supported equal boundary and first supported unequal boundary, using run start or end when necessary. Cite record identifiers, distinguish mismatches from explanations, and attach a next supplied-record or dictionary check. Log and cap manual inspections at twelve per pair. Within sixty minutes, produce all six reports. In the additional twenty minutes, compare this workflow with ordinary digest-ledger review on the two disjoint three-pair subsets, apply the stipulated removals during final review, freeze outputs, then open the supplied answer sheets and compare correctness, interval coverage and inspection counts.
assumptions: Field definitions establish comparable artifact boundaries; when they do not, the result remains unresolved.

assessment: Viable incumbent combining the supplied digest comparator and evidence ledger. No missing record or blank warning proves nonexecution; no timestamp anomaly establishes its cause. Supplied synthetic observations and resources support the workflow proposal, without demonstrating efficacy.
